say:0:1220503001:0.text: There are pig tracks here, and they look like they've been dragged away!
say:0:1220503001:0.source_cn: 主人，这里有猪的脚印，而且像是被拖走的！
say:0:1220503001:0.male: There are pig tracks here, and they look like they've been dragged away!
say:0:1220503001:0.female: There are pig tracks here, and they look like they've been dragged away!

say:1:1220503002:0.text: If we follow their trail, we should find the Wights who stole them!
say:1:1220503002:0.source_cn: 我们沿着痕迹向前，应该就能找到劫走它们的水鬼帮了！
say:1:1220503002:0.male: If we follow their trail, we should find the Wights who stole them!
say:1:1220503002:0.female: If we follow their trail, we should find the Wights who stole them!
